lines.en: Lina, you look excited! What are you going to do for your birthday?
lines.pt: Lina, você parece animada! O que vai fazer no seu aniversário?

lines.en: I’m going to have a party at home. My mum told me that she was going to bake a cake.
lines.pt: Vou fazer uma festa em casa. Minha mãe me disse que ia assar um bolo.

lines.en: I used to hate my birthday, but now I love big parties.
lines.pt: Eu costumava odiar meu aniversário, mas agora adoro festas grandes.

lines.en: Really? Did you use to hate it? Why?
lines.pt: Sério? Você costumava odiar? Por quê?

lines.en: When I was small, my cousin told me that clowns were scary, so I cried.
lines.pt: Quando eu era pequena, meu primo me disse que palhaços eram assustadores, então chorei.

lines.en: Poor you! I’m going to invite twenty friends, and we are going to dance.
lines.pt: Coitada! Vou convidar vinte amigos, e vamos dançar.

lines.en: Who is going to bring the music? Last year, Sam told me that he would do it.
lines.pt: Quem vai trazer a música? No ano passado, o Sam me disse que faria isso.

lines.en: He told me that he would bring his speakers. I’m going to buy balloons today.
lines.pt: Ele me disse que traria as caixas de som. Vou comprar balões hoje.

lines.en: Balloons are great. We used to have balloons at every party in my family.
lines.pt: Balões são ótimos. Nós costumávamos ter balões em todas as festas da minha família.

lines.en: Did you use to have a cake with candles too?
lines.pt: Vocês também costumavam ter um bolo com velas?

lines.en: Yes, and my dad used to hide my present in the garden.
lines.pt: Sim, e meu pai costumava esconder meu presente no jardim.

facts.label: Revisão: used to, told me e planos
facts.sub: Use used to + verbo base para hábitos do passado, told me that + verbo recuado para contar o que alguém disse e going to para planos já decididos.

facts.label: costumava
facts.sub: Use used to + verbo base para um hábito que não existe mais: I used to hate my birthday. Na pergunta e na negativa, volta use to: Did you use to…? I didn’t use to…

facts.label: me disse que…
facts.sub: Para contar o que alguém falou, use told me + that + verbo recuado: She told me that she was going to bake a cake. Will vira would: He told me that he would come.

compare.ask: She told me that she was going to come.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ela me disse que ia fazer um bolo” e “eu costumava odiar”.
compare.tip: Diga: “She told me that she was going to come.”
compare.us: Em inglês, no discurso indireto o verbo recua: She told me that she was going to bake a cake. Para hábito do passado, use used to + verbo base: I used to hate it.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: She told me that she was going to come.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: A party room in Dublin · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cloudy afternoon in Dublin. Lina is going to have a birthday party. Flo used to organise parties with her family. They talk in a small party room. Many people told Lina that they would come. She wants everything to be perfect.

“Lina, you look excited! What are you going to do for your birthday?” says Flo. “I’m going to have a party at home. My mum told me that she was going to bake a cake.” says Lina. “I used to hate my birthday, but now I love big parties.” says Flo.
